title: Lighthouse Activation Intent
description: A deterministic, digest-bearing declaration: 'I intend to move from profile A to profile B' (LHP-PROFILE-14B, ADR-0016). The bridge object between the transition preview and a FUTURE activation capability — the natural payload for the activation endpoint's transition_reference input. It is NOT an approval, NOT an authorization, NOT execution: authorizes_activation is a digest-covered constant false and validation rejects anything else. It is an HONEST artifact: the embedded preconditions result records the true evaluation at build time, so blocked/invalid transitions are representable — recorded, never executable. References are bindings, never copies. IDEMPOTENCY SEMANTICS: two activation attempts are the same intended transition iff their artifact_digest values are equal (intent_id/created_at are handles, digest-EXCLUDED); duplicate prevention belongs to the future execution ledger, transition lock, and single-request endpoint semantics — none exist yet. This document is a human/Gateway-facing reference mirror; the AUTHORITATIVE enforcer is modules/activation_intent.py (ActivationIntent.validate(), which also RECOMPUTES artifact_digest).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Unknown/future versions fail closed.

intent_id.description: Unique handle (lhintent-<hex16>). Excluded from artifact_digest (volatile) — identity lives in the digest, not the id.

created_at.description: Timezone-aware ISO-8601 build timestamp. Excluded from artifact_digest (volatile). Never gate on it.

current_profile_id.description: Declared current state ('from profile A'), recorded from an explicit valid ActiveProfileState. Both current_* null = foundation activation (same semantics the shipped Gateway classifier reads from the preview); half declarations are rejected.

current_profile_version.description: Version of the declared current profile; null iff current_profile_id is null.

target_profile_id.description: 'To profile B' — always required; an intent without a target is invalid. Consumers: future activation packet; execution plan request_profile_activation inputs.

target_profile_sha256.description: Content binding of the target profile (recompute vs the live registry at ceremony). Required when preconditions_decision is 'ready'.

preview_id.description: Id of the reviewed transition preview. Required when ready.

preview_digest.description: The preview's artifact_digest — binds the preview and, transitively, every digest-covered producer fact inside it (the packet's 'producer fact references', by reference not copies). Same binding names as the shipped Gateway approval contract. Required when ready.

backup_manifest_id.description: Backup evidence reference by id. Required when ready.

backup_manifest_sha256.description: Backup evidence reference by CONTENT (sha256 of the manifest file bytes, per LHP-PROFILE-14A). Required when ready.

preconditions_decision.description: The activation-preconditions evaluator's decision at build time (the packet's 'validation result'). 'ready' is a statement about preconditions, never an authorization. Unknown never becomes ready; consumers must re-evaluate, never trust this alone.

preconditions_reasons.description: Stable snake-case reason tokens, deterministic order. Must be empty iff decision is 'ready'; a non-ready intent must state at least one reason (fail-closed honesty).

authorizes_activation.description: The anti-confusion pin: an intent NEVER authorizes anything (no path where 'approved' = 'activated'). Identity-checked at runtime — true, 1, and string stand-ins are all rejected. Digest-covered.

artifact_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical intent content (sort_keys, compact separators). Excludes exactly: intent_id, created_at, and itself. This digest IS the producer-side idempotency identity. validate() recomputes and compares.
